title: Accessing the Wordbank database
text: looking total vocabulary size, admins need, since productive receptive vocabulary sizes calculated. looking specific items subsets items, need load instrument data, using get_instrument_data() function. Pass instrument language form, along list items want extract (item_id). default get_instrument_table() returns data frame columns administration’s data_id, item’s num_item_id (numerical item_id), corresponding value. include administration information, can set administrations argument TRUE, pass result get_administration_data() administrations (way can prevent administration data loaded multiple times). Similarly, can set iteminfo argument TRUE, pass result get_item_data(). Loading data fast need handful items, time scales linearly number items, can get quite slow need many . , ’s good idea filter items need calling get_instrument_data(). example, let’s say want look production animal words English Words & Sentences age. First get items want: get instrument data items: Finally, calculate many animals words child produces median number animals age bin:
code: get_instrument_data(   language = "English (American)",   form = "WS",   items = c("item_26", "item_46") ) ## # A tibble: 20,296 × 6 ##    data_id item_id value    produces understands dataset_version ##      <dbl> <chr>   <chr>    <lgl>    <lgl>       <chr>           ##  1  396587 item_26 produces TRUE     NA          v2.0            ##  2  396587 item_46 produces TRUE     NA          v2.0            ##  3  396588 item_26 produces TRUE     NA          v2.0            ##  4  396588 item_46 produces TRUE     NA          v2.0            ##  5  396589 item_26 produces TRUE     NA          v2.0            ##  6  396589 item_46 produces TRUE     NA          v2.0            ##  7  396590 item_26 produces TRUE     NA          v2.0            ##  8  396590 item_46 produces TRUE     NA          v2.0            ##  9  396591 item_26 produces TRUE     NA          v2.0            ## 10  396591 item_46 produces TRUE     NA          v2.0            ## # ℹ 20,286 more rows items <- get_item_data(language = "English (American)", form = "WS") animals <- if (!is.null(items)) items %>% filter(category == "animals") animal_data <- if (!is.null(animals)) {   get_instrument_data(language = "English (American)",                       form = "WS",                       items = animals$item_id,                       administration_info = TRUE,                       item_info = TRUE) } if (!is.null(animal_data)) {   animal_summary <- animal_data %>%     group_by(age, data_id) %>%     summarise(num_animals = sum(produces, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%     group_by(age) %>%     summarise(median_num_animals = median(num_animals, na.rm = TRUE))      ggplot(animal_summary, aes(x = age, y = median_num_animals)) +     geom_point() +     labs(x = "Age (months)", y = "Median animal words producing") }

title: Accessing the Wordbank database
text: fit_aoa() function computes estimates items’ age acquisition (AoA). needs provided data frame returned get_instrument_data() – one row per administration x item combination, minimally columns age num_item_id. returns data frame one row per item aoa column estimate, preserving item-level columns input data. AoA estimated computing proportion administrations child understands/produces (measure) word, smoothing proportion using method, taking age smoothed value greater proportion.
code: if (!is.null(animal_data)) {   fit_aoa(animal_data)   fit_aoa(animal_data, method = "glmrob", proportion = 1/3) } ## # A tibble: 43 × 8 ##      aoa item_id item_kind item_definition category lexical_category uni_lemma ##    <dbl> <chr>   <chr>     <chr>           <chr>    <chr>            <chr>     ##  1    24 item_13 word      alligator       animals  nouns            alligator ##  2    23 item_14 word      animal          animals  nouns            animal    ##  3    23 item_15 word      ant             animals  nouns            ant       ##  4    18 item_16 word      bear            animals  nouns            bear      ##  5    20 item_17 word      bee             animals  nouns            bee       ##  6    NA item_18 word      bird            animals  nouns            bird      ##  7    21 item_19 word      bug             animals  nouns            bug       ##  8    19 item_20 word      bunny           animals  nouns            bunny     ##  9    22 item_21 word      butterfly       animals  nouns            butterfly ## 10    NA item_22 word      cat             animals  nouns            cat       ## # ℹ 33 more rows ## # ℹ 1 more variable: complexity_category <chr>

title: Accessing the Wordbank database
text: One item-level fields uni_lemma (“universal lemma”), intended approximate semantic mapping words across languages Wordbank. function get_crossling_items() simply gives available uni_lemma values. function get_crossling_data() takes vector uni_lemmas returns data frame summary statistics item mapped uni_lemma language (WG forms). row combination item age, columns indicate number children (n_children), means (comprehension, production), standard deviations (comprehension_sd, production_sd), item-level fields.
code: get_crossling_items() ## # A tibble: 2,125 × 2 ##    uni_lemma dataset_version ##    <chr>     <chr>           ##  1 1PL       v2.0            ##  2 1PL.POSS  v2.0            ##  3 1PL.REFL  v2.0            ##  4 1SG       v2.0            ##  5 1SG.POSS  v2.0            ##  6 1SG.REFL  v2.0            ##  7 2PL       v2.0            ##  8 2PL.POSS  v2.0            ##  9 2PL.REFL  v2.0            ## 10 2SG       v2.0            ## # ℹ 2,115 more rows get_crossling_data(uni_lemmas = c("hat", "nose")) %>%   select(language, uni_lemma, item_definition, age, n_children, comprehension,          production, comprehension_sd, production_sd) %>%   arrange(uni_lemma)

title: wordbankr 2.0.0
text: get_crossling_items() now fails gracefully (message + NULL) database unreachable, like every data-access function. get_* functions (summarise_items(), wb_dataset()) gain version argument pinning data release, replacing options(wordbankr.dataset_version = "v1.2") global option. db_args argument removed get_* functions (already ignored 2.0.0). get_* functions now record data’s dataset_version column output; version = "current" (default), resolved actual current version tag (e.g. "v1.5") rather literal string "current". Breaking (dataset v2.0+): get_administration_data(), date_of_test now Date (previously string), nested language_exposures column exposure_proportion renamed exposure_percentage (values always percentages, 0-100). ASL CDITwo item ids normalized "Item_N" "item_N". Redivis dataset (v2.0+) uses normalized schema — child-level variables live children table instrument-level variables instruments — get_administration_data() joins back together, flat output shape unchanged.

title: wordbankr 2.0.0
text: Data now come versioned Wordbank dataset Redivis (https://stanford.redivis.com/datasets/627v-9ewzpdvz0) instead MySQL database. get_* functions keep signatures return data. New: pin analyses data release options(wordbankr.dataset_version = "v1.2") full reproducibility. get_administration_data(filter_age = FALSE) now returns administrations outside instrument age range flagged source data (previously reachable age filter’s absence). connect_to_wordbank(), get_wordbank_args(), db_args argument deprecated ignored. get_crossling_items() now returns single uni_lemma column derived item mappings; internal database id column uni-lemmas unattached item longer included. redivis client suggested (imported) dependency, installable https://langcog.r-universe.dev; wordbankr prompts install command missing. network access retries transient failures fails gracefully (message + NULL), test example requires network access CRAN.
